correctness.rationale: Exact mass-matrix normal equations checked, with all endpoints. Homogeneous tails alternate and decay at least by 1/2; central Schur equations reduce to F=2-6u+3u², G=1-3u². Four sign cases prove the sum of both tail bounds and center is <=3. Stieltjes signed-jump decomposition proves every BV input; symmetric geometric grading yields limiting 3-3/2^(m+1) and thus a global sharp supremum. Exact arithmetic checker independently verified 8,205 step cases, 55,608 piecewise-constant cases, and seven rational grading examples. Finite checks are supplemental.

value.rationale: A mesh-uniform sharp variation norm for continuous degree-one L2 projection answers a natural stability question in approximation and finite-element reconstruction. The theorem covers arbitrary positive nonuniform meshes and all real BV data, and identifies a nontrivial, geometrically graded asymptotic extremizer, distinguishing it from the classical L∞ bound despite the same numerical constant.
